content_sections.heading: About DIBD-DIC
content_sections.text: The Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD) is an Independent Business Division under Digital India Corporation (DIC), with its Delhi office at Electronics Niketan, Lodhi Road, New Delhi. It manages and executes BHASHINI, the National Language Translation Mission, an initiative of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology under the Digital India Program. The BHASHINI platform works with premier academic institutes, including IITs and IIITs, and hosts more than 300 AI-based language models.

content_sections.heading: DIBD-DIC Cloud Engineer Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The designation is allocated according to the candidate's experience level. The post is in the Digital India BHASHINI Division and reports to the CEO-DIBD. content_sections.heading: DIBD-DIC Cloud Engineer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age for application is 58 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of the applications. A Full time B.S./B.Tech. /B.E. or equivalent degree or B.Sc. (IT/CS) with a Post-Graduation in a Technical Background may be considered. 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing cloud-based solutions using AWS, Azure, or GCP, including compute, storage, networking, and security services. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and observability tools, and applying DevOps practices for high-availability and performance optimization. MBA/M. Tech. Strong proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, including deployment, scaling and service networking (an added advantage). Proven experience in Infrastructure-as-Code and automation using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Chef or Puppet. Solid understanding of cloud networking (VPC/VNet, subnets, routing, load balancers, firewalls) and data platforms (SQL/NoSQL databases, caching systems). Formal educational qualifications and experience may be relaxed for exceptional candidates. See the official notification (PDF) for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The Cloud Engineer will design, implement and manage scalable cloud infrastructure, keeping systems secure, reliable and optimized for performance while supporting application deployment and operations. The notice lists these duties: Design and implement scalable, secure, high-availability technical solutions inspired by large digital platforms. Translate business and functional requirements into end-to-end technical architectures and solution designs. Support onboarding and integration of partner applications and services into the platform ecosystem. Architect and manage cloud infrastructure for AI, data and application workloads. Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code and automation using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation and Ansible. Implement cloud operations best practices, including autoscaling, configuration management and cost optimization. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for platform and application deployments. Monitor, troubleshoot and optimize cloud and application environments for performance and reliability. Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams and solution blueprints for internal teams and partners. Work with internal teams to identify gaps, improve processes and enhance solution delivery. Deliver customer service in a client-facing role, using strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened on qualifications, age, academic record and relevant experience. DIBD-DIC may fix a higher threshold of qualifications and experience to limit the number of candidates called for interview. Only shortlisted candidates are invited for selection interviews. DIBD-DIC reserves the right not to select any candidate, and to fill all, some or none of the positions, without assigning any reason. A candidate selected in this interview could also be considered for other vacant positions at DIBD-DIC that require similar skills, at an appropriate level.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary, for the project of DIBD-Digital India Corporation. The appointee gets no right or claim to permanent appointment, or to any vacancy that exists or is advertised in future. The appointment can be terminated with one month's notice, or without notice on payment of one month's salary in lieu. The place of posting is Noida/Delhi or other locations as per project requirements. Candidates from other locations may also be considered if deemed suitable. The role requires flexibility and availability to travel as and when business needs demand it.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DIBD-DIC Cloud Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the details of the post from the MeitY, DIC, BHASHINI or NeGD website. Fill in the application on the Digital India Corporation online application portal by 15 November 2026. If you are in regular or contractual employment under Central or State Government, a Public Sector Undertaking or an Autonomous Body, apply through proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate from your employer. You may instead produce the certificate at the time of interview. The only document the notice specifically asks for is the No Objection Certificate, and only from candidates in the employment listed above.

faq.question: Q1. Which designation will the selected candidate get?
faq.answer: It can be Assistant Manager, Deputy Manager or Manager Technical Solutions. DIBD-DIC allocates the designation based on the candidate's experience level.

faq.question: Q2. Can a B.Sc. graduate apply for the Cloud Engineer post?
faq.answer: A B.Sc. (IT/CS) with a Post-Graduation in a Technical Background may be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Which cloud platforms should my experience cover?
faq.answer: The notice asks for 3+ years of hands-on work on AWS, Azure or GCP, covering compute, storage, networking and security services.

faq.question: Q4. Is an MBA or M.Tech compulsory?
faq.answer: No. The notice marks MBA/M. Tech as preferable, not essential.

faq.question: Q5. On what date is the age of 58 years checked?
faq.answer: The maximum age is counted as on the last date of receipt of the applications, which is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How is the salary decided?
faq.answer: Pay depends on the selected candidate's qualification and experience, and is fixed as per industry norms.

faq.question: Q7. Can a candidate living outside Delhi or Noida be considered?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says candidates from other locations may also be considered if deemed suitable.

faq.question: Q8. Whom can I contact with a query?
faq.answer: The contact officer is Ms. Vinaya Viswanathan, Director- HR, DIBD-Digital India Corporation, Electronics Niketan Annexe, 6 CGO, Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003. The phone numbers are 011-24303500 and 24360199.
